requirements_summary: Scale: index ~18M documents (legal dockets + contracts + email archives) initially; plan to grow to 60M over 18 months
Query volume: 8k-12k queries/day during business hours, peak ~400 qpm; expected steady-state 100 qps during enterprise review windows
Latency SLOs: median <250ms for 1-stage retrieval+embedding match; end-to-end rerank (embedding + LLM-based reranker) target p95 <850ms
Cost sensitivity: target backend cost per query <$0.02 token-equivalent (embeddings + rerank amortized); procurement focused on predictable monthly committed spend
Indexing architecture: hybrid ANN + stored metadata; need near-real-time ingestion for compliance holds (minutes-level freshness for some collections)
Reranking: use small LLM reranker for precision over recall; must support runbook toggles to fall back to classical BM25 for SLA-critical flows
Security/compliance: VPC or on-prem control plane preferred; KMS-backed key ownership; immutable audit logs with configurable retention up to 7 years; SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning
Data residency: primary US; some EMEA partitions for EU client data (must support region routing)
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms, and trace links for disputed search results
notes: Customer background: incumbent search is Elastic + custom rerank microservice. Pain: maintenance cost, drift of embeddings infra, and unpredictable tail latency.
They care most about: predictable cost for discovery workflows, audited retention for evidentiary trails, and easy key ownership (customer-managed KMS).
Quote from CISO: 'We need defensible logs and a playback of what model returned what snippet — legal-grade traceability.'
